cmd: echo ---CRON-ROOT; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^#" | cut -c1-170; echo ---CRON-UBUNTU; crontab -l -u ubuntu 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^#" | cut -c1-170; echo ---SYSTEMD; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "vps|weather|bridge|agent" | cut -c1-110; systemctl list-timers 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "vps|weather" | cut -c1-110; echo ---GITDIRS; find /opt /root /home -maxdepth 4 -name .git -type d 2>/dev/null; echo ---REMOTES; for d in $(find /opt /root /home -maxdepth 4 -name .git -type d 2>/dev/null); do r=$(dirname $d); echo $r $(git -C $r remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed "s#//.*@#//***@#") $(git -C $r rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); done; echo ---BRIDGE; grep -nE "git |push|commit|api.github|repo" /opt/vps-github-bridge/vps_github_bridge.py | head -25 | cut -c1-150
